description:
Get Buffet's curated lineup of real-life events and hangouts for a week in a city (Los Angeles today).

Use this for "what's going on in LA this week / this weekend", "things to do in Los Angeles", or "where can I meet people this weekend". Lineups run Monday to Sunday and the picks are mostly Thursday to Sunday evenings: free concerts, festivals, art walks, happy hours, a restaurant hangout. Each pick is somewhere a person can join a table of up to six strangers through the Buffet app.

Returns the picks in date order with venue, neighborhood, time (Pacific), price tier, tags, a short description, the organiser's page when there is one, and app_url (the link to join). Use buffet_search_events instead to filter by day, neighborhood, price or interest.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

week.description: "this" (default), "next", or a lineup week id like "2026-W43" (weeks run Monday to Sunday)

name: buffet_get_weekly_lineup
title: This week's lineup
